# Message Lifecycle

MessageLifecycle is the orthogonal domain model for sending, sync, edit, recall, ephemeral state, and read receipt semantics.

## Boundary

The core/host owns lifecycle. UI receives state and emits retry, cancel, edit, and recall intent.

## States

Transport states such as sending, sent, delivered, read, and failed must not collapse with edited, recalled, or ephemeral dimensions into one magic number.

## Presentation

`visualStatus` is a presentation projection; it is not MessageLifecycle.
